But recently he has started to speak Spanish with his father at home. For example when he wants my husband to help him he calls him in Spanish, when they are doing something together they talk Spanish or when we are in the living room but and I’m reading a book they have conversations in Spanish. It feels like they are excluding me, or like they didn’t want me to understand them. But my son didn’t, he know refuses to speak with me and only speaks with my husband. I understand that my son liked it but it was really uncomfortable to not know what my own son was saying.
